Triage note — filed, **not claimed**. Reading taken 2026-09-07T06:2xZ.

**File surface** (read from the source tree at `c383352`, not inferred from the title):

| File | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:33` | add `locale` to `SeedSchema` (`strictObject`, so an app cannot add it) |
| `packages/spec/src/data/seed-loader.zod.ts` | add `locale` to `SeedLoaderConfigSchema` |
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:2486` | `filterByEnv` becomes the composition of both axes; single call site at `:490` |

**Cross-domain, deliberately not split.** The surface spans `packages/spec` (`domain:spec`) and
`packages/metadata-protocol` (`domain:engine`). It should stay one card: a `locale` key accepted by
the schema but ignored by the loader is a declared-not-enforced surface, and an app writing the key
would silently get both datasets — strictly worse than today, where the app at least knows it has to
select the dataset itself.

Per the cross-domain exception path this needs the triage seat to designate one lane PM. Noting for
whoever picks it up: `packages/spec` belongs to the spec seat under the sole-owner rule, which the
cross-lane direct-pickup path does not waive.

**Why this was not dispatched by the seat that filed it.** Seat readings at the time of filing —
`domain:spec` (#6017) green with in-flight dev 3/3 and produce timestamped 2026-09-07T05:20Z, no
handover brief; `domain:engine` (#6367) green. Round mutual-exclusion therefore stands down. The
card is left open, `pm:queue`, no assignee, which is the state the owning lane consumes.

**Origin.** Reported from `objectstack-ai/kpi`, an Apache-2.0 app on `@objectstack/spec@17.2.0`,
where the workaround described in the body is currently in production use. That app carries the
interim fixture; it will be removed when this lands.

`:1642`, confirmed by grep). The declared file surface held — nothing in the diff touches #16488's

draft-publish path in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`. A grep at `c383352` found nothing
there. Re-derive the full list against current `main` rather than trusting either reading.

**Both requested follow-ups filed:**

- #16595 — wire `config.locale` at the runtime call sites, flip the liveness row to `live`
- #16596 — reconcile rows already written under a locale that is no longer active

Both carry `Blocked-by: #16510`. #16596 was the one I had initially declined to file for want of a
decided owner; the report supplied the judgement (the loader is the only layer holding both
`externalId` and the provenance keys), so it is filed with the remaining decisions written into it.

**What this card is now waiting on, and it is not the PM.** PR #16592 is a draft carrying
`needs:contract-review`, and it touches a governed path (`skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md`,
+1 generated line). Under the red lines the dispatching seat does not flip it ready, queue it, arm
auto-merge, approve it, or merge it — the contract review is another seat's or the maintainer's.
The `needs:contract-review` label is the inbox that carries it there; nothing further for me to flip.

PM keeps the PR watched until it merges or closes.
